root.label: USGA adds Merion Golf Club as fourth anchor site

events.label: USGA adds Merion Golf Club as fourth anchor site

slots.name: anchor sites
slots.sentence: Merion joins Pebble Beach, Oakmont and Pinehurst as anchor sites that have key championships on a recurring basis.

slots.name: championships hosted
slots.sentence: Merion has hosted the most USGA championships (20), though it went 32 years between U.S. Opens when Justin Rose won his lone major in 2013.
